Le Coq]] Premium Liiga''' due to sponsorship reasons,{{#invoke:cite|web|title=Kodune tippjalgpall saab peatoetaja|date=26 February 2013|access-date=11 December 2013|language=et|publisher=Estonian Football Association|url=http://vana.jalgpall.ee/premium/news.php?id=4629}} is the 36th season of the [[Meistriliiga]], the top Estonian league for [[association football]] clubs since its establishment in 1992. The season began on 7 March 2026 and will conclude in November.{{#invoke:cite|web|title=2025 Meistriliiga|date=26 February 2025|access-date=26 February 2025|language=en|publisher=UEFA|url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/est/domestic/league/1034/}} == Teams == The league consists of ten teams; the top nine teams of the previous season, and one team promoted from the [[Esiliiga]]. [[FC Flora|Flora]] entered the season as defending champions. The promoted team was the [[2025 Esiliiga]] champions [[FC Nõmme United|Nõmme United]] (returning to the Meistriliiga after a single-season absence). They replaced the [[2025 Meistriliiga]] bottom-placed team [[JK Tallinna Kalev|Tallinna Kalev]] (relegated from the Meistriliiga after four seasons). === Stadiums and locations === {{Location map+ |Estonia |width=325 |caption=Locations of the 2026 Meistriliiga teams |places= {{Location map~ |Estonia |lat=59.42132100|long=24.73211300|label_size=80 |label=Tallinn |mark=Blue pog.svg |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Estonia |mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png |marksize=1 |lat=60.22 |long=21.55 |label_size=80 |label='''{{nowrap|Tallinn teams:}}'''
